create_augmentation_subclass: create a subclass of Augmentation that defines get_transform to generate a Transform for image data augmentation
build_augmentation_list: build an AugmentationList to apply a sequence of augmentations in order to an AugInput object
create_aug_input: create an AugInput object with an image ndarray and optional boxes and semantic segmentation mask
apply_augmentations: apply a list of augmentations to an image or AugInput and return the transformed inputs and transforms
test_aug_input_transform: test AugInput.transform to in-place transform image, boxes, and semantic segmentation with a Transform
